description:
1. Goal: display the AI response generation time carried in assistant message metadata, read directly from the chat entry header.
2. Format constraint: minutes and seconds only, minutes never carrying into hours (`000:07s`, `012:45s`, `125m 03s`).
3. Created `src/utils/duration.js` (`formatGenerationTime`, `formatElapsed`) and replaced four duplicated `moment(0).add(s,'s').format('mm:ss')` helpers in `ChatEntry.vue`, `ChatEntryMetadata.vue`, `ChatEntryDrawer.vue`, `ChatMessageList.vue` — fixing the ≥60 min truncation to `00:00` and dropping unused `moment` imports.
4. `ChatEntry.vue` was rewritten in full and saved; new requirement is a live 1 s ticking counter from `start_time` while the message streams, then a clock icon whose `title` carries the total once finished — the old value was invisible because it was `null` on empty metadata and `hidden` below `@lg/panel`.
5. Pending: the last `ChatEntry.vue` and `src/utils/duration.js` change blocks were emitted truncated, so those two files still need a complete, verified write before the live counter and clock icon are actually in place.

messages.content: Message genartion time. Show how long is taking for an AI response to be processed in 000:00s (min and seconds) (none must be longer than hours but all can happen) info is in the message metadata

I'll start by orienting in the project and checking what's already documented.## 1. Review & Understand the Request - Show the **AI response generation time** (`meta_data.time_taken`, seconds) that already travels in the chat message metadata. - Format it as **`000:00` (minutes and seconds)** — minutes must not wrap/truncate into an hours field, since a response can last from a second to well over an hour ("none must be longer than hours but all can happen"). ## 2. Information Gathering (confirmed) | Finding | Evidence | | --- | --- | | Generation time is `time_taken` (seconds, float) in the message metadata; `first_chunk_time_taken` also exists | `src/components/ChatEntryMetadata.vue:34-35`, `104-106` | | Four places render it, each with a **local `moment(0).add(seconds,'s').format('mm:ss')`** helper | `ChatEntry.vue:927-938`, `ChatEntryMetadata.vue:146-150`, `ChatMessageList.vue:554-558`, `ChatEntryDrawer.vue:154-158` | | Bug: `moment` `mm` is 0–59, so ≥ 60 min renders wrong (`3600s` → `00:00`), and `000`-style minutes are not possible | moment format tokens | | Shared helpers live in `src/utils/*.js` (JSDoc-headed ES modules) | `src/utils/desktopSizes.js`, `highlight.js`, `meetCode.js` | | Message header display is `model mm:ss` | `ChatEntry.vue:81` + `927-938` | | `moment` in `ChatMessageList.vue`/`ChatEntryDrawer.vue` is used **only** by that helper (would become an unused import) | `ChatMessageList.vue:267,556`, `ChatEntryDrawer.vue:102,156` | ## 3. Change Proposal Create one pure formatter returning **`MMM:SSs`** (`000:42s`, `012:45s`, `125:03s`) — minutes `padStart(3, '0')` computed with integer division so they grow past 999 instead of rolling into hours — and use it everywhere the generation time is displayed. Remove the four duplicated (buggy) helpers. Files: | File | Change | | --- | --- | | `src/utils/duration.js` | **new** — `formatGenerationTime(seconds)` | | `src/components/ChatEntryMetadata.vue` | use helper in the Duration card, drop local `formatDuration` | | `src/components/ChatEntryDrawer.vue` | use helper in footer, drop local helper + unused `moment` import | | `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue` | use helper in footer, drop local helper + unused `moment` import | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | `timeTaken` computed uses helper (fixes ≥60 min truncation) | Risk: **low** (no dependents/tests per `project_impact`). ## 5. The Changes /** * Chat message generation time. * * Assistant messages report how long the AI took to produce the response in * their metadata (`meta_data.time_taken`, in seconds). A response can take a * fraction of a second or well over an hour, so the minutes field is never * folded into hours: the value is always rendered as `MMM:SSs` * (e.g. `000:07s`, `012:45s`, `125:03s`). */ /** Width of the minutes and seconds fields. */ const MINUTES_WIDTH = 3 const SECONDS_WIDTH = 2 /** * Format a duration in seconds as `MMM:SSs` (minutes and seconds). * * Minutes are zero padded to three digits so the value stays tabular, and they * keep growing instead of carrying into an hours field — a response may run * longer than an hour and must still be readable. * * @param {number|string} seconds duration reported in the message metadata * @returns {string} `MMM:SSs`, or `000:00s` when the value is missing */ export function formatGenerationTime(seconds) { const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0)) const minutes = Math.floor(total / 60) const remainder = total % 60 const mm = String(minutes).padStart(MINUTES_WIDTH, '0') const ss = String(remainder).padStart(SECONDS_WIDTH, '0') return `${mm}:${ss}s` } `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue` — three localized hunks (file is 772 lines): {{ formatGenerationTime(activeMessageData.metadata.time_taken) }}
